data.body: Corrected review candidate: e6cc07a366bfd9904b4aa2aab4661758685ec0d1 (Change-Id I63a406c865a1b1fe5ab3517e6c352e59300cae5c). The initial prose review findings were corrected: the S3 prefix is generated rather than operator-supplied, and issue-count comparisons belong only to dual-project fetch and preview. Certified-basis normalized AST/directive checks, seven-scenario collection, lint, typecheck, trailer validation, diff integrity, and worktree hygiene pass; the result is 656 to 200 words. Per operator direction, full make verify is deferred to Gerrit CI. This exact SHA still requires a different reviewer to post the final three-row receipt.
